trailhead.label: Path 443 trailhead above the Passo Giau car park

cautions: Heat risk is high on this walk: start early and carry extra water.
Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
A short steep rocky section in zig-zags on path 443.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Path 443 trailhead above the Passo Giau: Inizio del sentiero 443 sopra il parcheggio del Passo Giau

textIt.A short steep rocky section in zig-zags: Un breve tratto roccioso ripido a zig-zag sul sentiero 443.
Guado di un torrente sul sentiero 443.
